description: Find Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) observation stations (staffed weather stations and AMeDAS automatic stations) by name and/or prefecture. Returns station_id (the handle jma_past_daily and jma_climate_normals take), Japanese name, kana, romaji, coordinates, elevation, which elements the station observes (precipitation, temperature, wind, sunshine, humidity, snow) and whether it has closed. Name accepts romaji ("Nozawa Onsen"), katakana or kanji. Pass prefecture (English or Japanese name, or 2-digit JMA area number; Hokkaido is 14 sub-areas) to be fast; without it every area is scanned. Sourced from the Japan Meteorological Agency, past weather data search.

observes.description: Only stations observing this element: precipitation, temperature, wind, sunshine, humidity or snow.

prefecture.description: Prefecture or Hokkaido sub-area, e.g. "Nagano", "長野県", "48".

query.description: Station name, e.g. "Nozawa Onsen", "野沢温泉", "Naha".

name: jma_station_search

data_as_of.description: Date the data is current to (ISO)

found.description: false when nothing matched; see reason

title: Jma Station Search
